title: Lesson 8
paragraph: 暮らしとお金のやりくり

words.meaning: to keep money over time so you can buy something later
words.japaneseMeaning: お金をこつこつ貯める
words.example: I'm trying to save up for a new bicycle.

words.meaning: to return money that you borrowed from someone
words.example: I will pay back the money on Friday.

sentencePractice.prompt: I owe you twenty pounds. Tomorrow I will ____ the money I borrowed, so I will not owe you anything.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Only returning borrowed money cancels this debt. Saving money or withdrawing it does not by itself repay the lender.

words.meaning: to divide the cost of a meal or service between people
words.example: We decided to split the bill equally after dinner.

sentencePractice.prompt: There are four of us, and our meals cost the same. Let’s ____ so that each person pays one quarter of the total.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The clue specifies dividing one charge into four equal payments. Saving money or dining at a restaurant does not specify how the bill is divided.

words.meaning: to test something by using it to see whether it works well
words.example: You can try out the new keyboard before you buy it.

words.meaning: to compare prices or products in different places before buying
words.japaneseMeaning: いくつかの店で比較する
words.example: Shop around before choosing your phone plan.

words.meaning: available at a lower price than usual
words.japaneseMeaning: 値下げして売られている
words.example: These boots are on sale this weekend: twenty percent off.
words.usageNote: ここでは「特売・値下げ中」の意味。for sale は値下げの有無にかかわらず「売りに出ている」。on sale が単に発売中を指す文脈もあります。

words.meaning: to create enough space for someone or something
words.example: Move those boxes to make room for another chair.

words.meaning: to begin living in a new home
words.example: We can move in as soon as the repairs are finished.

words.meaning: to leave a home because you will live somewhere else
words.example: The tenants will move out at the end of the month.

words.meaning: to organize a party for other people
words.example: We want to throw a party for our friend's birthday.
